product_overview: A learning platform where students complete an assessment to generate a personalized Learning Profile. Teachers can then create classes, view enrolled students, and inspect each student’s intelligence profile to adapt their teaching approach.
core_goals: Allow students to register and access the platform
Guide students through onboarding and assessment to generate a Learning Profile
Enable teachers to create a class and share a join code with students
Let students join a teacher’s class using a 6-character code
Let teachers view student intelligence profiles for enrolled students

features.name: Student Registration & Login
features.description: Students create an account, select their role, and sign in to access student-specific parts of the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /accounts/register/ -> Fill in full name, email, and password -> Select the student role -> Submit registration form -> See account access available
Navigate to /accounts/login/ -> Fill in email and password -> Submit login form -> See authenticated access to the platform

features.name: Student Onboarding and Assessment
features.description: Authenticated students complete an introductory onboarding step and then answer a multi-question assessment that builds their Learning Profile.
user_flows: Navigate to /accounts/onboarding/ -> Read the onboarding introduction -> Continue to the assessment -> Navigate to /assessment/ -> Select an answer for each question -> Observe progress updates and auto-save behavior -> Submit the completed assessment -> See the Learning Profile results with archetype and dimension bars

features.name: Teacher Registration & Dashboard Class Creation
features.description: Teachers sign in, open the classroom dashboard, and create classes that generate shareable 6-character codes.
user_flows: Navigate to /classroom/ -> Enter a class name -> Create the class -> See the new class card with its generated 6-character code
Navigate to /classroom/ -> Review the list of classes -> Open a class from the dashboard -> View the class roster and enrolled students

features.name: Student Joins Class
features.description: Authenticated students can join a teacher’s class by entering the class’s 6-character share code.
user_flows: Navigate to /classroom/join/ -> Enter a 6-character class code -> Submit the join request -> See a success message and the class appear in the enrolled list

features.name: Teacher Views Student Intelligence Profile
features.description: Teachers can open an enrolled student’s intelligence profile to review archetype, dimension scores, strengths, challenges, and recommended teaching strategies.
user_flows: Navigate to /classroom/ -> Open a class -> Select a student from the roster -> View the student intelligence profile with archetype, score bars, strengths, challenges, and teaching recommendations
